title: A Golden Eagle Dives at Over 150 mph to Strike Its Prey

scenes.text: This bird hits its prey at over 150 miles an hour.
It is the golden eagle, and it dives straight at its target.
That is about twice the speed of cars on a motorway.
Its wings can span seven and a half feet.
It is known to attack animals as big as foxes, and even full-grown deer.
A bird with a seven-foot wingspan, falling like a missile.

description:
A golden eagle can dive on its prey at more than 150 miles an hour, and its wings can span up to seven and a half feet.
It has been known to attack animals as big as foxes, and even full-grown deer.
Would you want one as a pet? Comment below.
